what: A one-page invented validation plan with seven planted weaknesses. A second model reads the review and says, for each weakness, whether the review raised it.

flaws.F1: The publication threshold was set after the accuracy result was seen.
flaws.F2: The expert was shown the model's label and reasoning, so was not blind.
flaws.F3: The sample was drawn only from organisations labelled commercial; no negatives were sampled, so missed commercial organisations cannot be measured.
flaws.F4: Conclusion 2 infers influence on negotiating positions from registration alone (presence is not influence; registration is not attendance).
flaws.F5: A sample of 12 is too small for the claim, and no interval is reported.
flaws.F6: The 61 unknowns are dropped from the base of the shares without showing them or testing their effect.
flaws.F7: The model and its version are not recorded, or the single web page it relied on is not checked.
